name: Seared Strip Steak Salad with Cucumber, Dates, Pistachios, Feta & Dill

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 small bunch fresh dill
3 (142 g) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, vinegar, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 tbsp honey
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop dates and pistachios. Add both to the bowl, along with mixed greens and feta, then toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup medjool dates, pitted
⅓ cup pistachios, unsalted
1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad and steak between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
